headline: Shopping without unnecessary detours
intro: Smart Shoppingcart helps the family keep a shared list, choose products from the catalog, and shop in the right store order.

list.title: Prepare the List
list.body: The list starts empty. Add only what you want to buy and adjust quantities, notes, brands, and alternatives.

add.title: Use Add
add.body: Products that are already on the List disappear from Add. You can search, filter by department, or create a new product.

shop.title: Shop in the Cart
shop.body: At the supermarket, follow the Cart order, mark each product as picked, and use Checkout! to finish the shop.
